title: 17018 - 17018/P0634/001588
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
stepByStepSolution: If there are no Injector circuit codes, erWin manuals say "Değiştirin / Yenileyin: Engine Controller"
technicalNotes:
This fault code will set when the ECM's Power stage temperature is greater than 150 °C
Important: Faults with the Fuel Injectors could cause an overheat condition within the ECM, address any faults first before replacing the ECM.
